axis: even-tempered endurance of delay or incompetence → a standing disposition of kindness and compassion

members.tone: Plain praise for a temper that absorbs delay or bungling without souring, the trait named as if it cost nothing.
Formal, and it makes the same tolerance sound deliberately held back - a reaction withheld where *patience* is simply an even temper.
The warmest of the three and the widest: not endurance of an annoyance but a whole bent toward kindness and compassion.
